visits_time_shape.name: visits_time_shape
visits_time_shape.value:
("visits"."all_day" and "visits"."starts_on" is not null and "visits"."ends_on" is not null and "visits"."ends_on" >= "visits"."starts_on" and "visits"."starts_at" is null and "visits"."ends_at" is null)
        or (not "visits"."all_day" and "visits"."starts_at" is not null and "visits"."ends_at" is not null and "visits"."ends_at" > "visits"."starts_at" and "visits"."starts_on" is null and "visits"."ends_on" is null)

visits_job_for_job_work.name: visits_job_for_job_work
visits_job_for_job_work.value: "visits"."kind" not in ('work', 'estimate') or "visits"."job_id" is not null

documents_status_matches_type.name: documents_status_matches_type
documents_status_matches_type.value: ("documents"."type" = 'quote' and "documents"."status" in ('draft', 'sent', 'viewed', 'accepted', 'declined', 'expired')) or ("documents"."type" = 'contract' and "documents"."status" in ('generated', 'part_signed', 'signed')) or ("documents"."type" = 'change_order' and "documents"."status" in ('draft', 'sent', 'approved', 'declined')) or ("documents"."type" = 'invoice' and "documents"."status" in ('draft', 'issued', 'sent', 'viewed', 'paid', 'void'))

ledger_entries_adjustment_has_memo.name: ledger_entries_adjustment_has_memo
ledger_entries_adjustment_has_memo.value:
"ledger_entries"."entry_type" <> 'adjustment'
        or ("ledger_entries"."memo" is not null and length(btrim("ledger_entries"."memo")) > 0)

ledger_entries_sign_matches_type.name: ledger_entries_sign_matches_type
ledger_entries_sign_matches_type.value:
"ledger_entries"."reverses_id" is not null
        or "ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'adjustment'
        or ("ledger_entries"."entry_type" in (
              'payment_received', 'chargeback_reversed'
            ) and "ledger_entries"."amount_cents" > 0)
        or "ledger_entries"."entry_type" = 'application_fee'
        or ("ledger_entries"."entry_type" in (
              'refund_issued', 'chargeback_opened',
              'processing_fee', 'payout'
            ) and "ledger_entries"."amount_cents" < 0)

notification_settings_hours.name: notification_settings_hours
notification_settings_hours.value: "notification_settings"."digest_hour" between 0 and 23 and "notification_settings"."quiet_start" between 0 and 23 and "notification_settings"."quiet_end" between 0 and 23
